data.name: Green Faith Acolyte
data.description: You have trained to channel your magical energies in ways that do not harm the natural world around you. Your spells work more efficiently on plants. You have trained to channel your magical energies in ways that do not harm the natural world around you. Spells you cast that deal damage, channel negative energy, or otherwise harm life do not hurt normal or magical plants. In addition, whenever you cast a spell that utilizes, heals, or enhances normal or magical plants, you cast the spell at +1 caster level.
